lead.body: Tehran said four tankers hit mines in the strait that carries a fifth of the world's seaborne oil, and ordered it closed further until the United States meets its conditions. The blockade was first imposed in April, lifted in June and reinstated in July. Vice President Vance and Secretary of State Rubio met Qatar's prime minister separately to discuss reviving talks.
lead.deck: Iran says four tankers struck mines in the Strait of Hormuz and its army chief orders the waterway shut tighter until Washington meets Tehran's terms — as the US naval blockade grinds on and Qatar's premier flies to the White House to revive talks.
lead.headline: MINES IN THE STRAIT

lead2.deck: The International Court of Justice rules Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya — a landmark first that campaigners say sets a precedent for the Gaza case.
lead2.headline: THE COURT'S VERDICT
